The Universal SSO for all Unmanaged Apps

Enable SSO for any browser based application. We don’t replace your IdP. We elevate it.

No integrations, no SSO tax, no passwords.

Watch a Video

Trusted by
first

Passwords aren’t security, they’re bait.

The Problem

Credential theft remains the number one cause of enterprise breaches.

Unmanaged applications including non-SAML, shadow SaaS and shared accounts, continue to authenticate using vulnerable passwords. These apps are not integrated with identity providers, which means they operate outside of your security controls.

Without visibility or enforcement, employees use critically weak and redundant passwords. Users adopt tools on their own, create shadow SaaS, and share login credentials to collaborate. Offboarding becomes manual and difficult to manage.

These unmanaged apps form security blind spots where attackers know they can succeed with simple credential-based attacks.

Unmanaged Becomes Managed

The Solution

Unixi elevates your existing IdP to every unmanaged app, eliminating passwords from any browser-based application. No integrations required.

What you gain:

  • One-button login for every user and every app
  • Central access control for unmanaged apps
  • Role and group-based permissions
  • Governance and audit ready compliance

Data Protection: 
By removing passwords from these apps, credential theft, phishing, AiTM, and password-based social engineering attempts are stopped at the source.

Experience SSO Like Never Before

Unixi's Universal SSO platform delivers a new reality over SaaS apps

  • 100% visibility
  • 100% control
  • 100% enforcement
Discover

Unixi discovers all unmanaged and SAML apps, shadow SaaS, shared accounts, use of weak and redundant passwords, where traditional SSO is being circumvented and more. Once you see it, you can finally control it. 

Control

Define your approved eco-system of applications, turn on “Login Restriction” and Shadow SaaS is halted. Users can’t spin up new apps without first receiving the proper approvals and then, will only be able to access new apps using Unixi’s uSSO.

Universal SSO & MFA

Enhances the End user experience via a seamless one-button login. Authentication is driven by Key Derived Authentication (KDA), a multi-key, multi-location system that guarantees complex authentication controls are never stored anywhere.

Audit Ready Compliance

Security & Business Values

Bring SSO to ALL Apps

Instantly brings any SaaS app into SSO without requiring integrations.

Eliminates the SSO Tax

Avoid SaaS app premiums for SAML support or integrations required by other SSO providers, a significant and immediate cost savings.

Enhanced Security & Phishing Resistance

Decentralized, passwordless approach prevents credential theft and mitigates systemic SSO risks.

Complete SSO Governance

Provides full control over app access, permissions, and user logins attempts, while revealing Shadow SaaS usage.
